dm_mate_value.definition: The number the market metaphor assigns to a person, as if it could be measured and compared.
dm_mate_value.example: He talked about his mate value instead of asking what she wanted.

emergency_travel_document.definition: A short-validity passport issued so you can return home, often same day. It normally allows one or two journeys.
emergency_travel_document.example: The emergency travel document is valid for this flight and one return.

lsc_commitment.definition: A decision to keep something going at a cost to yourself, made again and again rather than once.
lsc_commitment.example: Commitment is not one decision; it is the tenth one as well as the first.

lts_romantic_availability.definition: The state of being open to a relationship and willing to say yes to the right one.
lts_romantic_availability.example: His romantic availability changed when he moved to another city, and he says so openly.

ma_compensation.definition: The correction you add or subtract after you have rounded a number.
ma_compensation.example: I rounded 19 up to 20, so the compensation is one lot of 24, and 480 − 24 = 456.
